source.how: get_computed_styles for the declared values (3OJY-0 the row, 3OJZ-0 its label, 3OK0-0 its indicator lane); get_children / get_node_info for the laid-out rects. Row 390 x 46 at the panel's 4px inset; label at (12, 12) 342 x 22; lane at (362, 15) 16 x 16.

note: The option row, from § Option rows / Rest — Select's row, which the sheet claims character for character, and the row every other row on this sheet (link, action, Try again, status) is drawn on. The law that matters is `track-is-the-sum-of-its-parts`: the fixed 16px trailing lane is what keeps labels aligned whether a row carries a tick, a link arrow or nothing, and the arithmetic only closes if the lane is really there on an EMPTY row.

lawsNotDeclared.concentric-radius: Neither child has a shape of its own — a line of text and an empty 16px lane — so there is nothing for the row's radius-sm to be concentric with. The row's radius answers to the PANEL's (radius-md over a 4px inset), which is Select's arithmetic and is asserted as a relationship to Select's panel in the contract suite.

deviations.what: The sheet's label box is 22px tall; the render's body-md line box is ~21.7px, so the row renders ~45.7px against the sheet's 46.
deviations.why: Paper rounds a text node's height to whole pixels and Chromium does not. Neither height is asserted: the laws read the four insets and the horizontal arithmetic, and those agree at 12 / 8 / 16 within the 0.5px tolerance.
